mantra.line: Stage 2 went from a break-break to a full 1,031-item keying pass, ten v4 distills, a written plot system, and three published TM pages, all inside the same 9/16 session.

Papi drew the gate tight: story side only, BOLO 24's own slice stays free, and the boresight's five rulings kept the sweep aimed at what plot, character and setting actually need instead of sprawling.
Papi caught the undercount himself — "are you sure this is all we have on plot and setting?" — and ordered the full pass with every agent needed rather than settle for the partial wave-2 count.

paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: Where the spine sweep stands: what Papi ordered on the 9/16 break-break, what already existed on disk before that, and what the record turned up once the library was actually counted.

strand.last: Stage 1, the Command-corpus sweep, was banked 8/26; stage 2, the library sweep, sat unfinished until the 9/16 break-break made it a gate.
strand.plan: Finish stage 2 to the end: keyed shelves, then distills, then written models, then technical-manual pages, then this status sheet.

items.t: **The 9/16 break-break:** "I don't want to move forward with any more of this [BOLO 24 / story work] until we figure out everything we need to do: take in all the data from Zotero and consider it in making models for the top layer of what story is — plot, characters, scenery."

**Boresight cleared, five rulings:** scope = all 1,031 items ("all of them, steps"); the distill template gets mind models ("Mermaid or other, a huge thing of that"); Blocked #8 ruled plot = 04; story side only gates on this, BOLO 24's slice stays free; product defaults to new SSOT docs, plot_systems first (provisional).
"Are you sure this is all we have on plot and setting?" — Papi caught the undercount, then: "run the full pass, take all the agents you need."
"Plot go" — the plot system ruled, all seven calls as recommended, v0.1.1.
"TM go" — the Technical Manual page type ruled, the CK3 hover layer standing as a blocking gate on every page from here.
Nine shelves, standing procedure at `_tools/zotero/README.md`: tags → PS TOC pass → title rules → subject default, a nine-step sweep with commands and token cost.

Ten distills on the v4 template, all through RANGE: BVX.0089 Dramatica · 0175 McKee *Story* · 0236 Coyne *Story Grid* · 0193 Truby *Anatomy of Story* · 0163 Snyder *Save the Cat!* · 0064 McKee *Character* (retrofit) · 0075 Davis *Creating Compelling Characters* · 0458 Kobold Guide · 0349 Kennedy *Against Worldbuilding* · 1122 GURPS *Renaissance Venice*.
Plot systems v0.1.1, written from the L4 shelf: `04_PLOT_SYSTEMS/📐 ssot_04_plot_system.md`, four axes, a twelve-layer PLOT SLICE, the PLOT CARD beside the SCENE CARD.
The setting system gained four OPEN candidates from the setting wave (the passageway · level of conflict · Kennedy's fill rule · what the trade cannot supply); the character system is untouched.
Three TM pages published — TM 04 plot, TM 03 setting, TM 02 character — built with `_tools/tm/`.
The wave-2 count had SETTING at 18 because 91 game-shelf sourcebooks and campaign settings hadn't been counted; the full pass corrected it to the true count of 154 — the undercount Papi flagged.
True shelf counts after the full pass: L7 174 · L4 162 · SETTING 154 · TEXTURE 105 · L5 82 · L6 27 · L0 27 · CRAFT-PROCESS 23.

The gap: 3,768 z-lib favourites not yet in the library, ranked per shelf — L7 353 · SETTING 297 · TEXTURE 224 · L4 166; Vogler, Field, Snyder's original PDF, Brody, Egri and Aristotle sit on the acquisition queue.
Owed: BVX.0541 duplicates 0458 (collapse owed); mind models owed on the setting and character docs; a PART A slice table owed on the character doc.

phases.t: **Stage 1, the Command-corpus sweep:** the repo's own processed materials (_SSOT · _CANON_NODES · _OXO_SCHOOL_HANDOFF · KNOWLEDGE_AREAS one-sheets · archive INDEX) mapped to spine addresses, banked as `01_NARRATIVE_FRAMEWORKS/📐 ssot_01_spine_house_inventory.md` (found the 03/03 numbering collision and the 0.6% distill stat).

**The boresight, cleared 9/16:** five rulings — scope all 1,031 items, the distill template gets mind models, Blocked #8 ruled plot = 04, story side only gates on this (BOLO 24's slice stays free), product defaults to new SSOT docs with plot_systems first.

**Step 1, inventory:** `_tools/zotero/inventory.py` reads the live Zotero DB into `INVENTORY-LIVE.md` — 1,031 items, 1,024 PDFs on disk, 265 new since the catalog, 208 already spine-keyed from Papi's 2023 tag scheme.
**Step 2, classify:** `classify_live.py` gave 943 of 1,031 items a subject (83 unmatched for eyes); `spinekey.py` keyed all 292 story-side items by tag, title rule, or flagged them for a TOC pass.

**The full pass:** every one of the 1,031 items keyed to every shelf at once — tags, title rules, seven PS batches reading 309 tables of contents, and a subject default — producing the true shelf counts and correcting the setting undercount.
**Wave 1:** four distills on the v4 template through RANGE — McKee *Story*, Coyne *Story Grid*, Davis *Creating Compelling Characters*, Truby *Anatomy of Story*.

**Wave 2:** the 44-title TOC pass finished keying or ruling off every story-side item; two more distills — Dramatica and the McKee *Character* retrofit — plus Snyder's *Save the Cat!* found mis-filed under a different author's name in Zotero.
**Plot systems v0.1:** `04_PLOT_SYSTEMS/📐 ssot_04_plot_system.md` written from the L4 shelf on an MS — four axes, a twelve-layer PLOT SLICE, the PLOT CARD beside the SCENE CARD, seven open calls.

**The setting wave:** four more distills — Kobold Guide, Kennedy's *Against Worldbuilding*, GURPS *Renaissance Venice* as the first setting-slice instance, plus setting addenda on Truby and McKee — bringing the total to ten v4 distills.

**The TM pages:** "TM go" — the Technical Manual page type built (`_tools/tm/`) and three pages published, TM 04 plot, TM 03 setting, TM 02 character, with the CK3 hover layer standing as a blocking gate on every page from here.
**DOPE SHEET 18 (this sheet):** built and published 9/16; FRAGO'd the same night with the character wave.

**The character wave:** five L5 distills through RANGE (Corbett 0196 · Card 0061 · Puglisi & Ackerman 0209 · Pelican 0233 · Schmidt 0045), then the character doc rewritten to v2.0.0 (slice table, three mind models, CHARACTER × LIBRARY, eleven OPEN calls; schema and the Victoria instance unchanged) and TM 02 republished with the rail lit. Fifteen v4 distills now; 73 of the shelf's 82 remain.

**The texture wave:** five TEXTURE distills through RANGE (the focalization volume 0598 · Bal 0596 · Hall 0273 · Kempton 0084 · Iglesias 0279), the texture system v0.1.0 written from the shelf in the plot doc's form (twelve T-layers ⧗, T11 MEDIUM and T12 FUNCTION as house additions, the OXO telling profile benched ⧗), TM 05 built and published. Twenty v4 distills now; 97 of the shelf's 105 remain.
**The genre wave:** 174 items on the L7 shelf, the largest of the nine.
**The doc upgrades:** mind models on the setting doc (1.1.0, TM 03 republished) and on the character doc (2.0.0, with the PART A slice table); BVX.0541 collapsed into 0458.

**The acquisitions:** Vogler, Field, Snyder's original PDF, Brody, Egri and Aristotle are not in the library and sit on the spine's OPEN list; the wider gap is 3,768 z-lib favourites not yet filed, ranked per shelf.
